text: How does the bank know a request really came from the merchant, exactly as the merchant wrote it?
prefix: How does the bank know a request really came from the merchant, exactly as the merchant wrote it?

text: Picture a shop's server asking the bank to create a payment.
prefix: Picture a shop's server asking the bank to create a payment.

text: The request already carries a token, the pass the merchant's API client received from the bank.
prefix: The request already carries a token, the pass the merchant's API client received from the bank.

text: But a token only says who you are.
prefix: But a token only says who you are.

text: It does not say that you wrote this particular request.
prefix: It does not say that you wrote this particular request.

text: And tokens leak.
prefix: And tokens leak.

text: One ends up in a log file, and anyone who reads that log can now ask for payments of any amount, with the buyer sent back to any address.
prefix: One ends up in a log file, and anyone who reads that log can now ask for payments of any amount, with the buyer sent back to any address.

text: There is a second danger.
prefix: There is a second danger.

text: Someone who records one honest request can simply send it again tomorrow.
prefix: Someone who records one honest request can simply send it again tomorrow.

text: So a pass alone is not enough.
prefix: So a pass alone is not enough.

text: Think of an old letter closed with a wax seal.
prefix: Think of an old letter closed with a wax seal.

text: The seal comes from your own ring, so nobody else can make it.
prefix: The seal comes from your own ring, so nobody else can make it.

text: A broken seal shows the letter was opened.
prefix: A broken seal shows the letter was opened.

text: A date shows when it was written.
prefix: A date shows when it was written.

text: And a serial number lets the reader notice the same letter arriving twice.
prefix: And a serial number lets the reader notice the same letter arriving twice.

text: The merchant's server does the same with every request.
prefix: The merchant's server does the same with every request.

text: It adds a request signature: a seal over every part that matters.
prefix: It adds a request signature: a seal over every part that matters.

text: The seal covers the method, which says create.
prefix: The seal covers the method, which says create.

text: It covers the full address the request goes to.
prefix: It covers the full address the request goes to.

text: It covers the token.
prefix: It covers the token.

text: It covers a fingerprint of the body, so the amount and the return address are sealed too.
prefix: It covers a fingerprint of the body, so the amount and the return address are sealed too.

text: And it covers the time and a one-time number.
prefix: And it covers the time and a one-time number.

text: The seal is made with a signing key.
prefix: The seal is made with a signing key.

text: That is a secret held by only two parties: the bank and this one API client.
prefix: That is a secret held by only two parties: the bank and this one API client.

text: The bank writes it straight into its key safe.
prefix: The bank writes it straight into its key safe.

text: The payments app can read it, but never change it.
prefix: The payments app can read it, but never change it.

text: When a request arrives, ecom checks it in a fixed order.
prefix: When a request arrives, ecom checks it in a fixed order.

text: First, the time must be fresh, inside the bank's chosen window.
prefix: First, the time must be fresh, inside the bank's chosen window.

text: Second, the body must match its fingerprint.
prefix: Second, the body must match its fingerprint.

text: Third, the API client named in the seal must be the one that owns the token.
prefix: Third, the API client named in the seal must be the one that owns the token.

text: Last, ecom makes the seal again with the same key and compares the two.
prefix: Last, ecom makes the seal again with the same key and compares the two.

text: Only then does it spend the one-time number.
prefix: Only then does it spend the one-time number.

text: That number is the nonce, and each nonce works once.
prefix: That number is the nonce, and each nonce works once.

text: A nonce is spent only after the seal checks out, so a forger cannot burn a merchant's numbers in advance.
prefix: A nonce is spent only after the seal checks out, so a forger cannot burn a merchant's numbers in advance.

text: One more rule follows.
prefix: One more rule follows.

text: Only the merchant's own switched-on website, with one of its own return addresses, can take a payment.
prefix: Only the merchant's own switched-on website, with one of its own return addresses, can take a payment.

text: Now watch it from the merchant's server.
prefix: Now watch it from the merchant's server.

text: It builds the body: the website, the order, the amount in cents and the return address.
prefix: It builds the body: the website, the order, the amount in cents and the return address.

text: It seals the request and sends it.
prefix: It seals the request and sends it.

text: The answer comes back at once.
prefix: The answer comes back at once.

text: The payment is created, and the answer carries the link to the bank's payment page.
prefix: The payment is created, and the answer carries the link to the bank's payment page.

text: In the merchant portal, the payments list shows one new payment, waiting for the buyer.
prefix: In the merchant portal, the payments list shows one new payment, waiting for the buyer.

text: Now the server sends the very same sealed request a second time, unchanged.
prefix: Now the server sends the very same sealed request a second time, unchanged.

text: The bank refuses it.
prefix: The bank refuses it.

text: The answer says the one-time number is already used.
prefix: The answer says the one-time number is already used.

text: Next, someone copies a request, changes the amount, and keeps the old seal.
prefix: Next, someone copies a request, changes the amount, and keeps the old seal.

text: The bank refuses it, because the body no longer matches.
prefix: The bank refuses it, because the body no longer matches.

text: Last, someone sends a request sealed long ago.
prefix: Last, someone sends a request sealed long ago.

text: The bank refuses that too, because it is no longer fresh.
prefix: The bank refuses that too, because it is no longer fresh.

text: After every refusal, the payments list stays exactly the same.
prefix: After every refusal, the payments list stays exactly the same.

text: Nothing new is created.
prefix: Nothing new is created.

text: What does this protect?
prefix: What does this protect?

text: Without the seal, a leaked token is a blank cheque.
prefix: Without the seal, a leaked token is a blank cheque.

text: Anyone could create payments in the merchant's name, for amounts the merchant never chose, and send the buyer back to a page the attacker controls.
prefix: Anyone could create payments in the merchant's name, for amounts the merchant never chose, and send the buyer back to a page the attacker controls.

text: Without the nonce, one recorded request becomes a copy machine.
prefix: Without the nonce, one recorded request becomes a copy machine.

text: The seal protects the merchant's name and every number in the request.
prefix: The seal protects the merchant's name and every number in the request.

text: The date and the nonce protect against copies.
prefix: The date and the nonce protect against copies.

text: And the key safe protects the key itself, because no person ever types it into the app.
prefix: And the key safe protects the key itself, because no person ever types it into the app.

text: So back to the letter.
prefix: So back to the letter.

text: The seal says it is yours and unopened.
prefix: The seal says it is yours and unopened.

text: The date says it is fresh.
prefix: The date says it is fresh.

text: The serial number says it is the only one.
prefix: The serial number says it is the only one.

text: Nobody can forge it, and nobody can post it twice.
prefix: Nobody can forge it, and nobody can post it twice.
